components.name: Home Header
components.description: Persistent identity and global attention summary.
components.css: .ds-home-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; min-height: 3em; padding: 0 2ch; border-bottom: 1px solid #494454; background: #15121B; color: #CBC3D7; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-home-header div { display: grid; } .ds-home-header strong { color: #D0BCFF; } .ds-home-header span { color: #C7C6C6; } .ds-home-header p { margin: 0; } .ds-home-header b { color: #FFB869; font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Metrics Panel
components.description: A compact two-by-two factual summary that follows project selection.
components.css: .ds-metrics { position: relative; padding: 1.1em 2ch .6em; border: 1px solid #494454; border-radius: 0; background: #0F0D15; color: #E7E0ED; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-metrics-title { position: absolute; top: -.65em; left: 1.5ch; padding: 0 .5ch; background: #0F0D15; color: #808080; } .ds-metrics dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: .45em 4ch; margin: 0; } .ds-metrics dt { color: #958EA0; } .ds-metrics dd { margin: 0; color: #D0BCFF; }

components.name: List Panel
components.description: A project or run list whose border and title make keyboard ownership explicit.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-list-panel { position: relative; min-height: 10em; padding: 1em 1ch .5em; border: 1px solid #808080; border-radius: 0; outline: none; background: #15121B; color: #E7E0ED; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-list-title { position: absolute; top: -.65em; left: 1.5ch; padding: 0 .5ch; background: #15121B; color: #808080; } .ds-list-panel:hover, .ds-list-panel:focus-visible, .ds-list-panel:focus-within { border-color: #8B5CF6; } .ds-list-panel:hover .ds-list-title, .ds-list-panel:focus-visible .ds-list-title, .ds-list-panel:focus-within .ds-list-title { color: #D0BCFF; } .ds-list-row { display: flex; gap: 1ch; padding: 0 1ch; } .ds-list-row-active { background: #2C2832; color: #E7E0ED; } .ds-list-row span { margin-left: auto; } .ds-list-row i { color: #FFB869; font-style: normal; } .ds-list-panel:hover .ds-list-row-active, .ds-list-panel:focus-visible .ds-list-row-active, .ds-list-panel:focus-within .ds-list-row-active { background: #D0BCFF; color: #0A0A0A; }

components.name: Quiet Selection Row
components.description: The visible cursor in a list that does not currently own keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-selection-quiet { display: flex; padding: 0 1ch; border-radius: 0; background: #2C2832; color: #E7E0ED; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-selection-quiet span { margin-left: auto; } .ds-selection-quiet:hover, .ds-selection-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #8B5CF6; outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Focused Selection Row
components.description: The high-contrast row in the list that owns keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-selection-focused { display: flex; padding: 0 1ch; border-radius: 0; background: #D0BCFF; color: #0A0A0A; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-selection-focused span { margin-left: auto; } .ds-selection-focused:hover, .ds-selection-focused:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #8B5CF6; outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-selection-focused:active { background: #E7E0ED; }

components.name: Command Input
components.description: A persistent command-only field with examples directly beneath it and a title cutout matching the home canvas.
components.css: .ds-command { position: relative; display: grid; gap: .2em; padding: .75em 1ch .5em; border: 1px solid #D0BCFF; border-radius: 0; background: #1D1A23; color: #D0BCFF; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-command > span { position: absolute; top: -.65em; left: 1.5ch; padding: 0 .5ch; background: #15121B; } .ds-command input { padding: 0 1ch; border: 0; border-radius: 0; outline: none; background: #1D1A23; color: #E7E0ED; font: inherit; } .ds-command input::placeholder { color: #958EA0; } .ds-command input:hover::placeholder { color: #CBC3D7; } .ds-command input:focus-visible { color: #D0BCFF; } .ds-command small { padding: 0 1ch; color: #D0BCFF; font: inherit; }

components.name: Hotkey Bar
components.description: Contextual keyboard guidance on the recessed footer surface, aligned to the left, center, and right edges.
components.html: ^n New RunEnter Focus runs   → Runs^q Quit
components.css: .ds-hotkeys { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr 1fr; padding: .45em 2ch 0; border-top: 1px solid #494454; background: #0F0D15; color: #CBC3D7; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-hotkeys span:nth-child(2) { text-align: center; color: #958EA0; } .ds-hotkeys span:last-child { text-align: right; } .ds-hotkeys span:hover, .ds-hotkeys span:focus-visible { color: #D0BCFF; outline: none; }

components.name: Status Markers
components.description: Compact semantic glyphs that communicate row state without filling the row.
components.html: ◆ Attention● Running✓ Complete× Blocked

narrative.overview:
LoopForge is a nocturnal, terminal-native operations surface: dense enough to keep the state of several projects in view, calm enough that a developer can scan it for long sessions. It feels like a purpose-built instrument rather than a decorated application. A restrained violet cast ties its black and graphite surfaces together, while lavender appears only where the current focus or next action must be unmistakable.

The interface stays flat, rectangular, and grid-bound. Hierarchy comes from tonal layers, borders, alignment, and a single inverted selection row rather than large type, illustration, or dimensional effects. Color is evidence: warm amber signals attention, coral signals a blocker, mint signals completion, and quiet gray carries neutral state.
keyCharacteristics: Dense two-panel scanning in a full-screen terminal frame.
Flat graphite layers with a subtle violet undertone.
Lavender focus treatments that are rare and unambiguous.
Monospaced alignment as both typography and layout infrastructure.
Contextual hotkey guidance that changes with the selected project and panel.

rules.name: The Focus Is Lavender Rule
rules.body: Lavender identifies current keyboard ownership or command affordance; it is not a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Status Is Sparse Rule
rules.body: Semantic colors belong on markers and short attention phrases, not across entire panels or rows.

rules.name: The One Grid Rule
rules.body: Keep every label, value, marker, and timestamp on the terminal's monospaced character grid so columns remain scannable without extra rules.

rules.name: The Persistent Console Rule
rules.body: Identity, current metrics, project/run context, command entry, and the relevant hotkeys remain visible together whenever terminal space permits.

rules.name: The Cursor First Rule
rules.body: Cursor movement is immediate; dependent project details are coalesced behind a 150 millisecond trailing delay, while Enter and Right commit them synchronously before changing focus.

rules.name: The Flat By Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add shadows, gradients, glow, translucency, or simulated physical elevation to the terminal workspace.

rules.name: The Cell Edge Rule
rules.body: Containers, focus states, and dividers align to terminal cells; no floating or partially inset geometry is used.

dos: Do keep the initial selection on `All projects` with the project panel focused.
Do use focus lavender for the active row and focus violet for the active panel border.
Do keep project counts, run ages, and metric pairs aligned to the terminal grid.
Do update metrics, filtered runs, and hotkey guidance together when project selection changes.
Do move the project cursor immediately, then render runs, metrics, adapter, and status once 150 milliseconds after the last Up or Down input.
Do cancel the pending detail delay and synchronize project details immediately before Enter or Right transfers focus to runs.
Do keep plain text inert in the command field and dispatch slash-prefixed commands only.
donts: Don't show `New Run` or `Ctrl+N` while `All projects` is selected.
Don't add a `New Project` action or shortcut to this surface.
Don't use whole-panel warning, error, or success fills; status color stays local to its marker or phrase.
Don't add rounded cards, shadows, gradients, decorative imagery, or proportional typography to the terminal workspace.
Don't introduce a second navigation or command path that diverges from the shared LoopForge behavior.
